cues: Here is the recipe for every Polaroid numerical.
Unpolarized light through the first sheet: always half.
Then, for each further sheet, multiply by cos squared of the angle between it and the sheet just before it.
Not the angle to the first sheet.
And a crossed pair gives zero.
